Jekyll Installation

Jan 10, 2025 · Dae-young Kim · #GitHub Pages #Ruby #Blog

  1. Follow Jekyll Installation Guides for corresponding operation system.
  2. gem install bundler
  3. Go to the Jekyll project directory.
  4. bundle install
  5. bundle exec jekyll serve
